questions.stem_text: Which statement is NOT true of a crisis management team?

options.A: All members should be trained in media relations.
options.B: A member of senior management should be included in the team.
options.C: A lawyer should be included in the team.
options.D: All members should be trained in group decision making.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - A lawyer should be included in the team.

questions.stem_text: The purposes for which the information is used is in the public's interest.
Secondary data has two important advantages over primary data. It is:

options.A: Capable of compensating for rapid environmental changes and technical improvements.
options.C: Seldom obsolete and usually fits the dimensions of your problem.
options.D: Generally cheaper to gather than primary data and takes less time to find.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Generally cheaper to gather than primary data and takes less time to find.
